name: Daily routine
starter: What does a typical morning look like for you?
sample: I usually wake up at seven, have breakfast, and then head to work.
followups: What time do you usually get up?
Do you prefer mornings or evenings? Why?
What do you do during your commute?

name: Food & cooking
starter: What is your favorite dish, and how would you describe its taste?
sample: My favorite dish is pho, because the broth is warm and full of flavor.
followups: Do you enjoy cooking at home?
What is the hardest dish you have ever made?
Which restaurant would you recommend to a foreign friend?

name: Travel
starter: Where would you love to travel next, and why?
sample: I would really like to visit Japan, because I am fascinated by its culture and food.
followups: Do you prefer traveling alone or with friends?
What is the most memorable trip you have taken?
How do you usually plan your trips?

name: Work & career
starter: What do you do for work, and what do you enjoy most about it?
sample: I work as a designer, and I enjoy solving problems creatively with my team.
followups: How do you handle a tight deadline?
Which skills matter most in your job?
Would you like to change careers someday?

name: Job interview
starter: Tell me a little about yourself and why you want this job.
sample: I have three years of experience in marketing, and I am excited about this opportunity.
followups: What is your greatest strength?
Can you describe a challenge you overcame at work?
Where do you see yourself in three years?

name: Ordering food
starter: Hi, welcome! Are you ready to order, or do you need a few more minutes?
sample: Could I see the menu, please? I would like the grilled chicken, and a glass of water.
followups: Do you have any food allergies I should know about?
Would you like something to drink with your meal?
Would you like to see the dessert menu?

name: Asking directions
starter: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the nearest train station?
sample: Go straight for two blocks, then turn left. It is across from the bank.
followups: Is it far, or can I walk there?
Do you know any landmarks near the station?
Have you ever gotten lost in a foreign city?

name: At the doctor
starter: Hello, what seems to be the problem today?
sample: I have had a headache and a slight fever since yesterday.
followups: How long have you felt this way?
Have you taken any medicine yet?
Are you allergic to any medication?

name: Shopping
starter: Do you prefer shopping online or in physical stores? Why?
sample: I usually shop online because it saves time and I can compare prices easily.
followups: Have you ever returned something you bought?
How do you decide if something is worth the price?
Do you enjoy looking for bargains?

name: Hobbies
starter: What do you like to do in your free time?
sample: In my free time, I enjoy reading novels and going for long walks.
followups: How did you first get into that hobby?
Would you like to try a new hobby this year?
Do you prefer hobbies you do alone or with others?

name: Movies & TV
starter: What is the last movie or show you really enjoyed?
sample: I recently watched a documentary about the ocean, and it was truly breathtaking.
followups: Who is your favorite actor, and why?
Would you recommend that movie to me?
Do you watch movies in theaters or at home?

name: Music
starter: What kind of music do you listen to when you study or relax?
sample: When I study, I usually listen to calm instrumental music.
followups: Have you ever been to a live concert?
Do you have a favorite song right now?
Can you play any musical instrument?

name: Sports & fitness
starter: Do you play any sports, or do you exercise regularly?
sample: I try to go running three times a week to stay healthy and keep my energy up.
followups: Do you prefer team sports or individual sports?
Who is your favorite athlete?
What is a good workout for a beginner?

name: Technology
starter: How has technology changed the way you live or work?
sample: Smartphones have made it much easier to stay in touch with my family.
followups: Do we spend too much time on our phones?
What app do you use every day?
How do you protect your personal information online?

name: Future plans
starter: Where do you see yourself in five years?
sample: In five years, I hope to be leading my own team and learning a new language.
followups: What goal are you working toward right now?
What would you like to improve about yourself?
Would you like to live abroad someday?

name: Small talk
starter: Hi there! How has your week been so far?
sample: It has been busy, but I am glad the weekend is finally here.
followups: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
How is the weather where you live today?
We should catch up over coffee sometime. Are you free?

name: Family & friends
starter: Tell me about your family. Who do you live with?
sample: I live with my parents and my younger brother, and we usually have dinner together.
followups: What do you usually do together on weekends?
Do you have a family tradition you really enjoy?
How often do you keep in touch with your friends?

name: Weather & seasons
starter: What is the weather like where you live today?
sample: It is quite hot and humid in the afternoon, but it cools down in the evening.
followups: Which season do you like the most, and why?
Do you check the weather forecast every day?
How does the weather affect your mood?

name: Environment
starter: What can people do to protect the environment in daily life?
sample: I try to recycle plastic bottles and turn off the lights when I leave a room.
followups: Should governments or individuals do more?
Have you noticed changes in your city air quality?
Which habit would you like to change to help the planet?

name: Vietnamese culture
starter: How do people celebrate Tết in your family?
sample: Every year, my family cleans the house and makes banh chung together before the New Year.
followups: What is your favorite food during Tết?
Which tradition would foreigners find most interesting?
How has the way people celebrate changed over the years?

name: Books & reading
starter: Do you enjoy reading? What have you read recently?
sample: I read a few pages every night before bed, mostly short novels and biographies.
followups: Do you prefer paper books or e-books? Why?
Is there a book that changed the way you think?
Would you like to write a book someday?

name: Education & studying
starter: What did you study at school or university, and why did you choose it?
sample: I studied economics because I wanted to understand how businesses make decisions.
followups: What is the best way for you to learn something new?
Would you like to study abroad? Why or why not?
What advice would you give to a student today?

name: Childhood memories
starter: What is one of your favorite memories from when you were a child?
sample: When I was little, my grandmother used to take me to the market every Sunday.
followups: What games did you play as a kid?
How has your hometown changed since then?
What did you want to be when you grew up?

name: Social media
starter: How much time do you spend on social media, and how does it make you feel?
sample: I spend about an hour a day scrolling, but I try to limit it before bed.
followups: Do you think social media is more helpful or harmful?
Have you ever taken a break from social media?
What kind of content do you enjoy watching online?

name: City vs countryside
starter: Would you rather live in a busy city or in the countryside? Why?
sample: I would prefer to live in a city, because there are more jobs and things to do.
followups: What do you miss most about your hometown?
How do you deal with traffic in your city?
What would make your city a better place to live?

name: Stress & wellbeing
starter: How do you usually deal with stress?
sample: When I feel stressed, I go for a walk or talk to a close friend.
followups: Do you think people talk about stress enough today?
What helps you sleep better?
How do you keep a healthy work-life balance?

name: Money & budgeting
starter: Are you good at saving money? How do you manage your budget?
sample: I try to save twenty percent of my salary every month, and I track my spending in an app.
followups: What is the most expensive thing you have bought recently?
Do you think it is important to learn about investing?
Would you rather have a high salary or more free time?

name: Living abroad
starter: Have you ever lived or worked in another country? What was it like?
sample: I spent six months in Australia, and it taught me a lot about independence.
followups: What is the hardest part about living in a foreign country?
What would you miss most about home?
Would you like to live abroad in the future?

name: A memorable meal
starter: Describe a memorable meal you had. Where were you, and who were you with?
sample: Last year, my friends and I had a seafood dinner by the beach, and the sunset was amazing.
followups: What is the best meal you have ever cooked for someone?
Do you prefer eating out or at home? Why?
What is a dish you would love to try in another country?
